comedians.bio: Host of Demo Night. High-energy stand-up about group chats, landlords, and a sourdough starter named Gerald.
British overthinker. Finds the existential dread in queueing, kettles, and weather small talk.
Istanbul-raised, Berlin-based. Jokes in two languages about expat life, bureaucracy, and his mother's voice notes.
Parisian storyteller turning metro rides and dating-app dates into five-minute tragedies with punchlines.
Lagos to London. Warm, rapid-fire observations on family group chats and airport security.
Deadpan German precision. Dark humor about productivity culture, flat-pack furniture, and her houseplants' will to live.
Madrid improviser. Builds entire scenes from one audience word, usually about someone's ex.
Osaka's most awkward export. One-liners and glorious on-stage failure, on purpose. Probably.
Sharp political satire with a storyteller's heart. Reads the news so you can laugh instead of cry.
Melbourne roast battler. Insults you lovingly, then shouts you a drink. Consent forms at the door.
Kyiv-born comic finding gallows humor in blackouts, dating apps, and bureaucracy.
Mexico City satirist. Sketches and stand-up about telenovelas, traffic, and his abuela's conspiracy theories.

shows.title: Demo Night: Live from the Living Room
shows.description: Our always-on demo stage. Ada tests new bits, the moderator tests new bleeps. Free forever, strictly fictional.

shows.title: Overthinking Everything
shows.description: An hour of spiralling about kettles, queues, and replying 'you too' when the waiter says enjoy your meal.

shows.title: Two Languages, One Mother
shows.description: TR-EN bilingual hour on expat life. Turkish and English, sometimes mid-sentence. Aynen öyle, exactly.

shows.title: Metro Tragedies
shows.description: True-ish stories from line 4: missed connections, dropped croissants, and one unforgettable accordion player.

shows.title: The Family Group Chat
shows.description: 243 unread messages and counting. Benny reads his family's finest forwards so you don't have to.

shows.title: Optimized Misery
shows.description: A productivity-guru takedown in 12 bullet points. Attendees receive a certificate of inefficiency.

shows.title: Yes, And... My Ex
shows.description: Fully improvised scenes built from your one-word suggestions. Pay what you want, laugh whether you want to or not.

shows.title: Failing Upwards
shows.description: Thirty minutes of jokes that almost work, delivered with total confidence. The failures are the show.

shows.title: Headlines & Punchlines
shows.description: The week's news, filleted live. No politicians were spared in the making of this show.

shows.title: Roasted, Lovingly
shows.description: Gus roasts volunteers from the chat. Front-row seats include emotional damage and a complimentary ice pack.

shows.title: Blackout Diaries
shows.description: Jokes by candlelight about power cuts, bad dates, and paperwork that reproduces when ignored.

shows.title: 60 Jokes, 60 Minutes
shows.description: One joke per minute or your mock money back. A tiny room, a huge clock, zero mercy.
